findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: CT log query found risky_hostnames_count=1: hostname staging.copperline.example, pattern staging, first_seen 2025-03-02, last_seen 2026-09-15; unique_hostnames=12.

findings.deal_impact: Publicly logged staging hostname suggests a pre-production system may be internet-reachable, increasing attack surface and diligence focus on staging access controls and data segregation; no severity adjustment from baseline.

remediation.summary: Inventory staging.copperline.example, confirm need for public access, restrict with authentication/VPN or remove, and review staging data and secrets exposure.

items.action: Inventory staging.copperline.example, confirm need for public access, restrict with authentication/VPN or remove, and review staging data and secrets exposure.

deal_recommendations.text: Require delivery of the current SOC 2 Type II report and a management security interview in Days 0–30 before relying on the B rating, consistent with Proceed with conditions.

Require completion in Days 61–100 after close of the staging inventory, access restriction by authentication/VPN or removal, and staging data and secrets review for $10K–$50K [F-001], consistent with Proceed with conditions.
Make no price adjustment, as the $10K–$50K remediation total is immaterial relative to the 50M-250M revenue band [F-001], with completion tracked in Days 61–100 under Proceed with conditions.

narrative.executive_summary:
Bottom line: Proceed with conditions — Copperline Analytics is rated B at 98.4, capped by limited evidence from outside-in signals only.

Key risks: A publicly logged staging hostname points to exposed pre-production access and attack surface [F-001]; no SOC 2 report was provided.

Management credibility: Not assessed: no management interview provided.

Next steps: Obtain the SOC 2 report and management interview before relying on the rating, and verify staging access controls and data segregation [F-001].
key_questions_for_management: Provide an inventory and access-control record for staging.copperline.example, including authentication and network restrictions [F-001].
Confirm whether staging.copperline.example requires public access and confirm its data segregation from production [F-001].
Provide the review of staging data and secrets exposure for staging.copperline.example [F-001].
Confirm the owner and completion evidence for remediation in Days 61–100 at $10K–$50K [F-001].
